change: Before legacy LAYOUT output preparation, join unchanged CLASSES evidence, captured LAYOUT bodies/roles, the source-bound NOD and ACAD_LAYOUT dictionary frames and memberships, the block-control membership, and unique R13/R14 forward associations. Source dictionaries reuse the existing version-aware dictionary wire observer; LAYOUT source reuses the bounded independent observer. A failed or changed join refuses output, and a successful join is still subject to the separate unqualified-projection refusal.

validation.samples: Generated R13/R14 ACadRust bound controls after normal producer reopen/save; no sample file committed. Original producer outputs omit the NOD registration and are refused before projection, with destinations preserved.
validation.mutations: On each resaved sample, mutate a physical LAYOUT frame, the physical layout dictionary frame, class number, NOD target, dictionary owner, dictionary member target, LAYOUT block target and block backlink. The source join rejects each, destination preservation checks cover ASCII and binary R2000 partial attempts, and restoring each field makes the same-adapter source join pass while export still refuses at the unqualified output gate.
validation.reproduction: Set LIBDXFRW_AC1012_LAYOUT_WIRE_SAMPLE and LIBDXFRW_AC1014_LAYOUT_WIRE_SAMPLE to the corresponding generated, resaved scratch DWGs and run the graph and wire CTests.
validation.asan: Fully instrumented library, CLI, adapter and the legacy layout, source-wire and graph mutation tests pass under AddressSanitizer.

limits: The join does not prove the full physical BLOCK_HEADER body or all target/dependency closures.
R13/R14 plain dictionaries have no wire cloning field; the required duplicate-merge semantics remain unqualified for native AutoCAD and R2000 target projection.

The controls are generated by a peer with ACadSharp lineage, not a native AutoCAD witness. A restored source passes the join, not successful output; R2000 DXF projection and independent physical readback remain open.
